description: TinyXML2 is a simple, small, efficient, C++ XML parser that can be easily integrated into other programs.

latest_release.name: v11.0.0
latest_release.body:
This is the same as the 10.1.0 release - the bug is in the version number, not the code. 10.1.0 does have an API change that was missed. (Details https://github.com/leethomason/tinyxml2/issues/1018)

Build fixes, typo fixes, fixed some internal int -> size_t. (Which will change the size of objects, but not the API.)
Fix https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-884x-p7qm-gq3f which was a problem parsing character encodings.
